verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's own materials claim the core of the story. The Unified Payments API says it connects "to all payment methods through a single API integration", Flow accepts payments "all through one simple integration", and the payment-methods page promises "all the local payment methods, digital wallets, and global card schemes". However, the only named method in the evidence is Google Pay, and that appears in the agentic-commerce (Google AI) context rather than standard checkout. missing for 10: named documentation of Apple Pay, bank-redirect methods and BNPL support, a method-coverage list showing these work via Flow or the single API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
